_about: Deliberate deviations from PubMed that check_publications.py must not flag. Each was decided by Evan; add the date and reason when you add one.

author_names._note: PubMed form -> form used on the site. Compound surnames as the authors write them (Evan, 2026-10-27). Aiyegbusi: PubMed indexes him two ways; the site uses Aiyegbusi OL throughout.

titles._note: PMID -> exact site title, where the site keeps a form PubMed does not use. 26113702: PubMed prefixes the Science section label 'SCIENTIFIC STANDARDS.' 29718639/25577940/25340235: NICE full guidelines keep the full-guideline document title; NCBI Bookshelf uses NICE's short title (open question for Evan, 2026-10-27).
titles.29718639: Bipolar disorder: The assessment and management of bipolar disorder in adults, children and young people in primary and secondary care
titles.25577940: Social anxiety disorder: The NICE guideline on the recognition, assessment and treatment of social anxiety disorder
titles.25340235: Psychosis and schizophrenia in adults: The NICE guideline on the treatment and management of psychosis and schizophrenia in adults

group_authorship_pmids._note: Entries whose author list cannot match PubMed's: PubMed lists only a group, or Evan is credited as a group member.
